Static http-server serving the bundled Halogen frontend

SDI lazy-spawn router. Listens on every marginalia-registered port whose startCommand contains the literal public port, spawns backends on first request (with port rewritten to +20000), proxies, and SIGTERMs after SDI_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS (default 10m). Status JSON at /state. Always-on services (marginalia API/whisper, LaunchAgent-managed, etc.) are implicitly skipped because their startCommand doesnt contain the port literal. Subcommands: --plan (dry-run), --audit (probe every registry row), --only PORT[,PORT…] (bind one subset).
